notes: colourMatik 1.7.3 — the real Windows fix, diagnosed on the affected machine: a stale system-level UXP registration (C:\Program Files\Common Files\Adobe\UXP\PluginsInfo) claimed the plugin id and blocked every copy, Adobe's installer agent must be told /remove by NAME not id, and it must be invoked from the system drive or every install fails with -198. The installer now cleans the system registry, fixes folder ownership, and registers system-level itself when the agent can't.
